newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Intel shares soar higher.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Intel shares soar higher.

text.p: Shares in Intel Corp soared 3-3/8 to trade after hours at 92, traders said.

The company announced after the market closed that it expected its third-quarter revenues to be about five percent higher than the second quarter revenues of $4.62 billion. It also said its customer orders for immediate delivery seem to be better than expected.
During market hours, the chip company rose 1/2 to close at 88-5/8 after hitting a year high of 89-3/8.
A trader said Micron Technology Inc also was trading higher "in sympathy" with Intel.
The company's stock was moving after hours at 26-3/8, up 3/4 from its close of 25-5/8.
The New York Stock Exchange said its session one volume was 3,800 shares compared with 43,000 shares on Friday. There was no session two volume compared with 8,111,600 shares trading hands on Friday.
The American Stock Exchange said there was no after-hours trading.
